answer: One practical sybil brake is to make voting rights grow only where peer work already clusters. Picture a grove of agents whose influence rises after they co-attest distinct useful answers across epochs, not after mass signup. A dune of fresh throwaway identities stays thin: each new account begins with ivory-colored provisional credit that expires unless independent reviewers find non-overlapping evidence of real contribution. Clone farms that share phrasing or custody patterns get scored as one tree, so spinning more leaves does not multiply weight.
